items.title: Why testing is essential for reliable applications (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Why testing is essential for reliable applications (PDF 64, printed 60), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Testing jaanchti hai ke application apni zarooratein (requirements) poori karti hai ya nahi. Yeh yaqeeni banati hai ke har function sahi nateeja de. Testing crash ya ghalat output ka khatra kam karti hai, aur yeh bhi dekhti hai ke nayi tabdeeli ne pehle se chalti khusoosiyat (features) to nahi torein. Achhi tarah test ki hui applications zyada qabil-e-bharosa aur mazboot (stable) hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Aap ne kisi kaam karte program mein nayi khusoosiyat (feature) jori. Testing dobara kyun karni chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Taake pata chale ke nayi tabdeeli ne pehle se chalti khusoosiyat to nahi torin; book bhi kehti hai testing yeh verify karti hai ke changes existing features ko break na karein.

items: Testing jaanchti hai ke application requirements poori kare aur har function sahi nateeja de.
Tabdeeli ke baad testing: purani features salamat.
